data.text:
Dubai’s real estate market has reached an unprecedented milestone on the global stage, with Zoya Ventures Real Estate proudly leading the way. Our agent, Christian Marzullo, represented Dubai’s property sector within the Italian Parliament, officially showcasing the emirate’s dynamic market to European lawmakers. 

This landmark moment not only underscores Dubai’s growing international influence but also highlights Zoya Ventures Real Estate’s role as a pioneer in bringing the city’s real estate voice to the world.

First Property Consultant to Address Italy’s Parliament: Christian Marzullo

On September 18, 2025, the Chamber of Deputies in Rome hosted a defining moment as Dubai’s real estate market was formally presented inside a national parliament for the first time in history. 

Christian Marzullo, an Italian luxury real estate broker based in Dubai, spotlighted the emirate’s booming property market. His presentation highlighted how Dubai has become a bridge between Italy and the UAE, offering unmatched opportunities for investors, enterprises, and individuals seeking global growth.

A Landmark Conference: Made in Italy 2030

The milestone took place during the prestigious conference ‘Made in Italy 2030: Professionals and Enterprises for a New Global Positioning,’ which convened influential entrepreneurs, policymakers, and industry leaders.

The conference, promoted by Italian MP Cristina Almici, brought together leaders to explore how Italian excellence can enhance its global role. By placing Dubai’s property market at the center of the discussion, Almici emphasized Italy’s ambition to deepen ties with leading international hubs.

Dubai’s Growing Appeal in the Global Landscape

Dubai was chosen for this stage because of its global reputation:

  • Trusted Investment Hub: Transparent regulations, freehold ownership, and Golden Visa opportunities.
  • High ROI: Rental yields averaging 6–8%, often higher than major European cities.
  • Cross-Border Appeal: Rising demand from European buyers, including Italians.
  • Economic Partnerships: Real estate as a bridge for cultural and business diplomacy.

This aligns with broader market sentiment. According to the Dubai Land Department, transactions in H1 2025 reached AED 431 billion, with Europeans playing an increasingly active role.

You can read more about these market dynamics in our Dubai Real Estate H1 2025 Report.

From Sicily to Dubai to the Italian Parliament

During his intervention, Marzullo introduced his upcoming autobiographical and motivational book, “AVE – Aspire. Value. Endure.”

The book chronicles his journey from Sicily to Dubai, and now to the Italian Parliament, underlining the values of resilience, ambition, and the timeless spirit of Made in Italy carried abroad. Marzullo stated:

From Sicily to Dubai, and now to the Italian Parliament, I wanted to demonstrate how Dubai’s real estate market can inspire new international synergies. This milestone proves that Made in Italy and Dubai can speak the same language: vision, ambition, and global appeal.

data.text:
The Bigger Picture: What This Means for Investors

For global investors, the recognition of Dubai real estate in the Italian Parliament sends a clear signal:

Institutional Confidence: Parliamentary-level acknowledgment validates Dubai’s market credibility.

Secure Growth: Tax-free benefits and long-term stability support reliable returns.

Rising European Demand: Italy now joins the UK, France, and Germany in driving European investment momentum.

Global Connectivity: Dubai remains a pivotal hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, and the Middle East.

Strengthening the Italy–Dubai Connection

The conference was streamed live on the official WebTV of the Italian Parliament, expanding its visibility and reinforcing Dubai’s positioning as a world-class destination for investors, entrepreneurs, and global citizens.

For Zoya Ventures Real Estate, this moment underscores the strength of Dubai’s property sector as a beacon for international collaboration and a catalyst for economic growth.

The entry of Dubai’s real estate market into the halls of the Italian Parliament is more than a symbolic milestone; it is a testament to how the emirate’s real estate continues to inspire confidence, connectivity, and opportunity on a global scale.

faqs.question: What makes Dubai attractive for European investors?

data.answer: Dubai stands out for European investors thanks to its high ROI of 6–8%, tax-free income, and strong rental yields. The Golden Visa program adds long-term residency benefits, while freehold ownership rights for foreigners provide security and full control. Together, these factors make Dubai both profitable and attractive for international investors.

faqs.question: What does this milestone mean for investors?

data.answer: It signals institutional trust in Dubai’s real estate and strengthens cross-border opportunities with Europe.
